title: 第4章 房产证写他的名字
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
“别墅？”

    “是啊，别墅就是独栋的，就是价格昂贵。”这可是郁嘉庆连想都不敢想的房子。

    郁凡若有所思的点点头，“那就它吧。”

    “现在时间还早，我们去买别墅吧。”郁凡想着最好今晚就能住进去。

    郁嘉庆瞪大眼睛，惊讶的叫道：“爸，你在开玩笑吗？！”

    “你看我像是开玩笑的样子？”郁凡一脸淡然的看着郁嘉庆。

    “可是，我们哪来的钱？”郁嘉庆想告诉郁凡现在的房价真的很贵，不是一般人可以买得起的。

    “放心，你直接带我去就行。”

    郁嘉庆还想说什么，可看到他父亲不耐烦的一眼，便咽下了想要拒绝的话。

    “爸，这个别墅都需要预定看房的，今天可能看不了。”

    郁凡没想到现在买个房也这么麻烦，只好无奈的说：“那行吧，那先去你之前说的房子那去看看。”

    看来今天是没法住进儿子所说的别墅了。

    郁嘉庆决定带郁凡去海景壹号和君城一品看看，也好让父亲了解一下现在的房价真的堪比天高。

    两人打车前往君城一品，郁嘉庆虽然有些心疼打车的费用，可想到父亲不爱和人接触的性格，便也不觉得有什么了。

    半个小时后，两人走进海景壹号售楼处。

    一位长相甜美的销售员走了过来：“先生，您好，请问你们是来看房子吗？”

    于璐看着两人长相相似，郁嘉庆看着年纪更大一些，猜测他应该是长辈，带着儿子来看房的。

    所以便直接询问郁嘉庆。

    郁嘉庆有些尴尬，不好意思说自己只是看看，不买。

    连忙说：“是我父亲要看房。”指了指郁凡的方向。

    “啊？是这位先生要买房？”于璐有些微楞，以为自己听错了。

    一个中年男人称呼一个年轻人为父亲，怎么想都奇怪。

    现在的人都玩这么大？

    “先生，您是想看多大的户型？或者您有什么购房要求？”

    “离人远点，环境要最好的。”郁凡言简意赅。

    于璐带着他们来到沙盘处，“您看看，如果要环境好，那自然只能选择高层房，视野要更开阔一些，现在高层的只有这几套房了。”

    郁凡扫了一眼楼盘模型，一眼便看中了中间最高的那栋楼。
content_en:
"Villa?"

"Yeah, the villa is a single-family house, but it's expensive." This was a house that Yu Jiaqing didn't even dare to think about.

Yu Fan nodded thoughtfully, "That's it."

"It's still early, let's go buy a villa." Yu Fan thought it would be best to move in tonight.

Yu Jiaqing's eyes widened and he shouted in surprise: "Dad, are you kidding?!"

"Do you think I'm joking?" Yu Fan looked at Yu Jiaqing indifferently.

"But where do we get the money?" Yu Jiaqing wanted to tell Yu Fan that the current housing prices are really expensive and not something ordinary people can afford.

"Don't worry, you can just take me there."

Yu Jiaqing wanted to say something else, but when he saw his father's impatient look, he swallowed his refusal.

"Dad, this villa needs to be booked for viewing. You may not be able to see it today."

Yu Fan didn't expect that it would be so troublesome to buy a house now, so he had no choice but to say, "Okay, let's go and have a look at the house you mentioned before."

It seems that I won’t be able to live in the villa my son mentioned today.

Yu Jiaqing decided to take Yu Fan to Haijing No. 1 and Juncheng Yipin, so that his father could understand that the current housing prices are really sky-high.

The two took a taxi to Juncheng Yipin. Although Yu Jiaqing was a little worried about the taxi fare, he didn't think it was a big deal considering his father's character of not liking to interact with others.

Half an hour later, the two walked into the sales office of No. 1 Seaview.

A sweet-looking salesman came over and said, "Hello, sir, are you here to look at the house?"

Yu Lu saw that the two looked similar, and Yu Jiaqing looked older, guessing that he should be an elder who brought his son to see the house.

So I asked Yu Jiaqing directly.

Yu Jiaqing was a little embarrassed and embarrassed to say that he was just looking at it and not buying it.

He quickly said, "It's my father who wants to see the house." He pointed in the direction of Yu Fan.

"Ah? This gentleman wants to buy a house?" Yu Lu was a little stunned, thinking she heard wrongly.

It's strange for a middle-aged man to call a young man his father.

Are people playing so big nowadays?

"Sir, what size of apartment do you want to see? Or do you have any requirements for purchasing a house?"

"Stay away from people and have the best environment." Yu Fan said concisely.

Yu Lu led them to the sand table, "Look, if you want a good environment, you can only choose a high-rise room with a wider view. Now there are only these few suites in high-rise buildings."

Yu Fan glanced at the real estate model and took a fancy to the tallest building in the middle.
title_en: Chapter 4: Write his name on the real estate certificate
